ayahs.textAr: حمٓ
ayahs.textEn: ha-Mĩm.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.textEn: By the clear Book!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺.

ayahs.textAr: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.textEn: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

ayahs.textAr: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

ayahs.textAr: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—

ayahs.textAr: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.

ayahs.textAr: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

ayahs.textAr: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ayahs.textAr: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible,

ayahs.textAr: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment.

ayahs.textAr: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

ayahs.textAr: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear,

ayahs.textAr: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textEn: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”?

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺.

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment.

ayahs.textAr: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them,

ayahs.textAr: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.

ayahs.textAr: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.textEn: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.textEn: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

ayahs.textAr: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”

ayahs.textAr: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.textEn: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”

ayahs.textAr: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind,

ayahs.textAr: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences,

ayahs.textAr: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.textEn: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed.

ayahs.textAr: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people.

ayahs.textAr: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.textEn: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

ayahs.textAr: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.textEn: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others.

ayahs.textAr: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textEn: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say,

ayahs.textAr: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected.

ayahs.textAr: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.textAr: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport.

ayahs.textAr: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped,

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.textEn: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

ayahs.textAr: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: will be the food of the evildoer.

ayahs.textAr: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
ayahs.textEn: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

ayahs.textAr: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: like the boiling of hot water.

ayahs.textAr: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire.

ayahs.textAr: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”

ayahs.textAr: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place,

ayahs.textAr: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: amid Gardens and springs,

ayahs.textAr: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another.

ayahs.textAr: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

ayahs.textAr: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: There they will call for every fruit in serenity.

ayahs.textAr: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textEn: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

ayahs.textAr: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.

ayahs.textAr: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful.

ayahs.textAr: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting.
